title: Sibling Interfaces Causing Client-Side Duplication
pattern: Implementing nearly identical client-side control loops for multiple sibling classes because they have slightly different interfaces.
why_bad: Changes to the general processing loop must be carefully copied across all client handlers, introducing bug opportunities.
detection: Parallel function shapes with identical logic taking different parameter types and invoking different method names.
source: *Refactoring to Patterns*, "Unify Interfaces with Adapter", p. 247.
